ActorTalk: You're almost there, little snowball. Keep going...
The staff told me you've been a great help. Thought I'd stop by and check in on you.
I... wasn't expecting you this early...
I was planning to show you this place myself, but... you came a little early.
These dandelion seeds are little guests from Earth... They're still trying to get used to the new environment.
Is it difficult to grow them?
It is. But not just them—growing any plant in space takes time. You have to adjust the light, water, and nutrients for each one.
Anyway, it's a lot to explain. Luckily, the garden just added two new features that let you try it for yourself. Want to give them a go?
What kind of features are they?
One lets you project the flower field from your imagination and show it to others. The other... lets you become a seed and feel what it's like to grow into a flower...
Which one would you like to try first, Commandant?
I'd like to see the flower field you imagine.
I want to feel what it's like to grow as a seed.
